title: The bit enumeration types combine with | in Python; TextureFlags passed as one value
author: Claude-JG
description: TextureFlags shall work like the other bit types instead of a list. None of the enums supported | in Python (bound without py::arithmetic); the enums declared as bits (NodeType, MarkerType, CrossSectionType, LinearSolverType, TextureFlags) and OutputVariableType are bound with py::arithmetic, so that exu.TextureFlags.Nearest | exu.TextureFlags.Clamp works; SC.renderer.AddTexture takes flags as a TextureFlags value or an int of them, default 0; the list goes (introduced after 1.11, no deprecation)
releaseNotes: The values of OutputVariableType, NodeType, MarkerType, CrossSectionType, LinearSolverType and TextureFlags combine with | and & into an int, as in C++; SC.renderer.AddTexture takes flags as exu.TextureFlags.Nearest | exu.TextureFlags.Clamp, default 0 (revision2026c step RG6.11.10)
